info.name: ShopSphere_Microservices_Collection
info.description:
ShopSphere: E-Commerce Microservices Platform (Java 17 / Spring Boot 3.2 / Spring Cloud 2023.0). All calls go through the API Gateway at http://localhost:8080.

Run the folders IN ORDER with the Collection Runner. Tokens and ids are stored in collection variables automatically.

Note: request/response field names for register, product and add-stock are assumed; adjust them to match your DTOs. Saved responses are examples.
